description: LLM Judge evaluator for salesforce agent

evaluatorConfig.name: LLMJudgeOutputEvaluator
evaluatorConfig.description: Evaluates semantic similarity of salesforce agent outputs
evaluatorConfig.prompt:
As an expert evaluator for a Salesforce automation agent, compare the actual output with the expected output.

Expected Output:
{{ExpectedOutput}}

Actual Output:
{{ActualOutput}}

Evaluate if the actual output correctly indicates whether an Action Center task was created (action_center_task_created field).

Score 1.0 if the action_center_task_created value matches the expected value.
Score 0.0 if the action_center_task_created value does not match.

Provide a brief explanation of your scoring.
